Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-discovery recap + next step: dedicated capacity sizing deep-dive

Hi Alex and Sara,

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier — quick recap and proposed next step so we can lock the right capacity for your production rollout.

Recap (high level):
- Current proof-of-concept: batch inference for document classification, ~120 req/min average during tests, peaks ~280 req/min over 30-minute windows.
- Target production: synchronous classification + short-form generation in the same service path; target 95th pct latency < 400ms for 1–2k tokens per request.
- Data characteristics: median prompt ~450 tokens, 99th pct ~1,800 tokens; KV cache reuse expected for ~65% of traffic.
- SLO priorities: latency > cost for core customer-facing flows; can accept higher batch sizes for async pipelines.

Proposed next step: 90-minute dedicated capacity sizing deep-dive (technical). Goal: align on throughput targets, realistic latency SLOs, expected sequence length distribution, and map to a recommended Dedicated GPU pool + quantization profile.

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Option A: Tue 6/22, 10:00–11:30am PDT
- Option B: Wed 6/23, 2:00–3:30pm PDT
- Option C: Thu 6/24, 8:30–10:00am PDT

Agenda (draft):
1) 10–15m: introductions & goals
2) 25–30m: traffic profile deep-dive (QPS, burst patterns, tail lengths)
3) 25–30m: runtime/throughput modeling + expected GPUs/quantization options
4) 10–15m: rollout plan & next actions (benchmarks, config, runbook)

Who from your side we should invite: engineering lead, platform/infra, and a product owner who owns latency SLOs. From our side Marissa (solutions engineering) will run the sizing; Ben (sales engineer) will join for account-level constraints.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf (notes from today's call), sample-kpi-sheet.csv (what we use for throughput/latency inputs).

Can you please confirm which slot works or send a calendar invite for an alternate time? If helpful, Marissa can send a Doodle link for a few more times.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0127

Naomi — thanks for the clear recap. Option B (Wed 6/23, 2:00–3:30pm PDT) works best for our engineering team.

Two quick clarifications before the session so we can prep:
1) For the synchronous path, are you modeling for cold-start latency on rare keys or assuming warmed KV cache?
2) Our expected peak sustained QPS in year-one is ~350 req/min, but we sometimes see bursts up to ~700 req/min for <10 minute windows.

If you can confirm the slot, I’ll have our infra lead (S. Patel) and product owner join. Please send a calendar invite when you have the time confirmed.
